title: Prefix circuit validation
statement: For every bit string $z$, membership in the prefix circuit-value language is equivalent to the specified circuit-code evaluator returning true on $z$. The language consists of pair encodings of a circuit code and an input string for which a well-formed circuit with fan-in at most two accepts the first $n$ bits of that string, for some $n$ no greater than its length.
caveat: The statement equates the language with a particular abstract evaluator; its detailed transition rules are lengthy and are not fully captured by the supplied informal descriptions.
